profile_text.body:
Adobe is a for-profit public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA, USA, trading on the stock exchange under the ticker ADBE. The company's most recent 10-K filing covers the period ending November 28, 2025, reporting revenue of $23,769,000,000. The harvested content focuses on Adobe Express, which the company describes as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool for creating social content, videos, logos, and similar material, with an AI Assistant that allows users to prompt, create, and edit content while preserving chosen elements across layers.

Adobe tracks several AI products across design, video, and audio categories. Adobe Express AI is positioned as a lightweight design tool with quick content creation capabilities and integration with Adobe Firefly, Adobe's image generation product, both of which the company describes as trained on commercially safe data. Premiere Pro AI extends those claims into professional video editing, offering features such as generative extend and color match, while Adobe Podcast AI addresses audio with speech enhancement and a microphone check tool, also described as commercially safe in its training.

The held facts record no litigation cases and no MCP server presence for Adobe at this time. The company holds a CIK of 0000796343 with the SEC, consistent with its status as a publicly traded corporation.
